title: 第23章 大客户
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
“儿子，这才一个时辰，那二十张佣兵佩剑就都卖出去了。足足赚了三千八百卡恩，这快快赶上我们店铺一个月的盈利了。”

    奇妙物语店铺内，林峰嘴上的笑容就没合拢过。

    林奇也是在计算着实际营收。

    “抛去一千卡恩的材料，盈利是两千八百卡恩。而且还有佣兵团还预订了三十张。还能赚四千二百卡恩……”

    他顿了顿，笔在纸上轻轻敲了敲。

    “也就是说，今天刚卖卡就抵得上以往一个月的营收，而且还不用老爹费心费力去收购日用品、跑运输……”

    最后，林奇得出一个结论，卖卡真是一本万利的买卖。

    “爹，以后商铺的日用品可以减少进货量了，我们要慢慢转型，主打卖卡业务。”

    “转型卖卡？”

    林峰眼睛一亮，连连点头。

    “好！听你的！卖卡可比卖日用品赚钱多了！”

    林奇将桌上的源晶卡收好，起身道：

    “我出去一趟，去万卡阁再囤些卡牌，中午不用给我留饭了。”

    他心里清楚，今天商铺卖卡的动静这么大，用不了多久就会传到万卡阁耳朵里。

    他要趁现在万卡阁还没反应过来，得赶紧多买些基础卡牌，不然以后说不定会被限制购买。

    其实林奇也知道，卖卡牌这种事情要想做长久，还得与万卡阁合作，毕竟他不是制卡师，无法自己制造卡牌。

    不过现在他还太弱小了，根本没有和万卡阁谈合作的资本，弄不好还会被对方吃的骨头都不剩。

    这也是他与凯恩示好的原因。

    万卡阁毕竟是个经营类的场所，既然他们员工的晋升途径对等卡牌的营业额，那林奇觉得投资凯恩这个新人，一定比和现在万卡阁的负责人谈生意要强。

    ……

    揣着所有积蓄，林奇快步走向万卡阁。

    刚踏入大门，就有一个穿着黑色制服的执事迎了上来，脸上挂着标准的笑容。

    “这位客人，请问有什么可以帮您的？”

    林奇扫了一眼执事的胸牌上面，莱德。

    “看来我前两次在万卡阁大额消费的事情，已经被万卡阁的管理层注意到了，不然也不会有执事亲自迎客。”

    林奇四处打量了一眼，发现凯恩还在柜台里苦逼的坐着，但眼神时不时会往门口瞟，显然也看到了他。

    林奇嘴角勾了勾，对莱德说：“不用麻烦了，帮我叫凯恩过来，我只和他谈生意。”

    那执事脸上的笑容都僵硬了。

    “客人，我的权限比凯恩高，可以给您最大优惠。”

    林奇瞥了他一眼，语气平淡却带着不容置疑的态度。

    “我是什么身份？你是什么身份？我买东西什么时候需要靠折扣省钱了？”

    “呃……”

    莱德被噎得说不出话，站在原地，脸色一阵红一阵白，不知道该如何是好。

    就在这时，一道温柔的女声传来。
content_en:
"Son, in just one hour, all twenty mercenary swords were sold. I made a full profit of 3,800 kahn, which is almost as much as our store's profit in a month."

    In the Wonderful Story store, Lin Feng's smile never closed.

    Lynch is also calculating actual revenue.

    "Throwing away the materials of one thousand Karns, the profit is 2,800 Karns. And there is a mercenary group that has reserved thirty pieces. We can still make 4,200 Karns..."

    He paused and tapped the pen on the paper.

    "In other words, just selling the cards today is equivalent to the previous month's revenue, and dad doesn't have to worry about buying daily necessities and running transportation..."

    Finally, Lynch came to the conclusion that selling cards was a very profitable business.

    "Dad, in the future, the store can purchase less daily necessities. We will slowly transform and focus on the business of selling cards."

    "Transition to selling cards?"

    Lin Feng's eyes lit up and he nodded repeatedly.

    "Okay! Listen to you! You can make more money selling cards than daily necessities!"

    Lin Qi put away the Source Crystal card on the table, stood up and said:

    "I'm going out to Wanka Pavilion to stock up on some more cards. There's no need to leave any food for me at noon."

    He knew in his heart that there was so much noise about card sales in the shop today that it wouldn't take long for it to reach Wanka Pavilion's ears.

    He had to buy more basic cards quickly before Wanka Pavilion could react, otherwise he might be restricted from purchasing them in the future.

    In fact, Lin Qi also knew that if he wanted to do something like selling cards for a long time, he would have to cooperate with Wanka Pavilion. After all, he was not a card maker and could not make cards by himself.

    But now he is too weak and does not have the capital to negotiate cooperation with Wanka Pavilion. If not, he may be eaten by the other party without leaving any bones.

    This is also the reason why he made peace with Kane.

    After all, Wanka Pavilion is a business place. Since the promotion path of their employees is equivalent to the turnover of the cards, Lynch feels that investing in Kane, a newcomer, must be better than negotiating business with the current person in charge of Wanka Pavilion.

    …

    Carrying all his savings, Lin Qi walked quickly to Wanka Pavilion.

    As soon as he stepped through the door, a deacon in black uniform greeted him with a standard smile on his face.

    "This guest, how can I help you?"

    Lynch glanced at the deacon's nameplate, Ryder.

    "It seems that my previous two large purchases at Wanka Pavilion have been noticed by the management of Wanka Pavilion. Otherwise, there would be no deacons to greet the guests in person."

    Lynch looked around and found that Kane was still sitting hard at the counter, but his eyes would glance at the door from time to time, and he obviously saw him.

    Lynch curled up his lips and said to Ryder: "No need to bother, help me call Kane over, I will only discuss business with him."

    The smile on the deacon's face froze.

    "Guest, I have higher authority than Kane and can give you the greatest discount."

    Lin Qi glanced at him, and his tone was calm but with an unquestionable attitude.

    "What's my status? What's your status? When do I need to rely on discounts to save money when I buy something?"

    "Uh..."

    Ryder was choked and couldn't speak. He stood there, his face turning red and white, not knowing what to do.

    At this moment, a gentle female voice came.
